jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Jobright is a fast-growing AI-native job platform in the U.S. seeking an AI Engineer to build and ship AI-powered products and features for users and businesses. The role involves developing applications, collaborating with teams, and iterating on product quality using user feedback.

Why Join Us

• Build real, production AI agents used by real users
• High ownership and impact
• Work at the intersection of AI, agents, and product
• Shape how people experience AI-driven job search

Responsibilities

• Build and ship AI-powered products and features for both users and businesses
• Develop agent-driven applications, workflows, APIs, and user experiences
• Work across the stack (backend or full-stack) to bring AI products from idea to production
• Collaborate closely with product, design, and business teams to solve real user problems
• Experiment with the latest LLMs, AI agents, and developer tools to improve product capabilities
• Continuously iterate on product quality using user feedback and data

Qualification

Required

• 1–5 years of software engineering experience
• Experience building AI-powered products, applications, or features using LLMs, AI agents, RAG, or similar technologies
• Expertise in either backend or full-stack development
• Strong ownership and ability to drive projects from idea to production
• Interest in building AI products for real users rather than focusing purely on research or infrastructure

Preferred

• Startup experience, or a strong passion for startup environments and rapid growth
• Hands-on experience building AI products used by real users
• Experience with modern AI developer tools such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, or similar
• Product-minded and comfortable operating in ambiguous environments

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Berkley Hunt is partnering with a well-funded, revenue-generating enterprise software company building an AI-powered platform that modernizes how engineering teams in a highly regulated industry manage requirements, traceability, and compliance.

They're hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to sit at the intersection of engineering and the customer: implementing the platform inside customer environments, configuring it around their real data and workflows, and feeding what they learn straight back into the product. This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco (3 days onsite) with and the company is only able to consider US citizens.

What You'll Do

Lead hands-on implementation and onboarding for new customers: configure the platform, import and migrate their data, and get teams productive fast
Build integrations, scripts, and workflow configurations using the platform’s API
Run technical demos on live customer data and support the sales team through the funnel: discovery, onsite visits, technical Q&A, and proofs of concept
Own the ongoing technical relationship with existing customers through regular touchpoints, troubleshooting and solving problems directly
Turn customer feedback into concrete product requirements and work with engineering to ship them, contributing code where it makes sense
Represent the company at industry conferences
Help shape the product roadmap based on direct customer signal

What We're Looking For

6+ years in a technical, customer-facing role such as forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering/architecture, implementation or integration engineering, or software engineering with significant customer exposure
Hands-on software skills are required: comfortable writing code (e.g. Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL), working with REST APIs, and handling data migration and integrations
Able to learn a complex technical product independently and quickly, without formal onboarding
Clear communicator across executives, engineers, and end users
A natural relationship-builder and subtle seller rather than a traditional salesperson; this is a culture-first hire
Experience implementing or supporting enterprise SaaS, ideally requirements management, systems engineering, PLM, or ALM tools, preferred
Exposure to aerospace, defense, or another highly regulated hardware industry a strong plus
Startup experience and comfort working in a small, fast-moving team preferred

Compensation & Benefits

Salary: $150,000 - $200,000 base

Defense and Space Manufacturing, Aviation and Aerospace Component Manufacturing, and Engineering Services

jobs.title: AI Agent Engineer
jobs.description:
This role is part of the Jobright Direct Hiring Network, where top companies like Cresta AI, Plaud, Mercor, OpenArt, and 1,500+ others hire top talent directly through our platform.

This is not a mass job posting. Only select, high-signal candidates are invited and recommended directly to hiring teams

Hiring Company: Creao AI

One-liner: CREAO is redefining the relationship between people and software by empowering users to create custom, conversational AI applications using natural language.

Salary:

Why Join Us:

Role Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and deploy AI agents using LLMs (e.g., GPT, Claude, open-source models)
• Build multi-step reasoning, planning, and tool-using agent workflows
• Integrate AI agents with internal systems, APIs, databases, and third-party services
• Implement evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance, reliability, and safety
• Optimize prompts, memory systems, retrieval pipelines, and agent architectures
• Collaborate with product, engineering, and design teams to translate real-world problems into AI-driven solutions
• Improve system scalability, latency, and cost efficiency
• Monitor agent behavior in production and continuously iterate based on feedback and data
• Ensure responsible AI practices, including privacy, safety, and bias mitigation

Qualitications

Required

• Strong software engineering skills in Python, TypeScript, or similar
• Experience working with LLMs, AI frameworks, or ML systems
• Understanding of agent architectures, such as: Tool use / function calling, Planning & reasoning, Memory & retrieval (RAG)
• Experience integrating APIs, databases, and distributed systems
• Ability to ship production-ready systems with reliability and observability in mind

Preferred

• Experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar
• Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Milvus, etc.)
• Knowledge of evaluation methods for generative AI systems
• Experience deploying AI systems on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)
• Background in ML, NLP, or autonomous systems
